messages:
Maria: quick update — saw a spike of 401s around 02:32 UTC this morning for service-account calls, correlates with yesterday's scheduled rotation
Ashwin: :eyes: which validation path failed? legacy token-validator or our new introspect proxy?
Maria: legacy token-validator returned "invalid_kid" for a subset of tokens; introspect proxy passed. looks like rotation produced mixed keysets for the same SA
sec-bot: INCIDENT_OPENED INC-2026-042: authz: inconsistent keyset after SA rotation. affected: api-gateway -> feature-search
Olivia: missing piece — audit logs for 02:30-02:40 are sparse. we have a 9m gap in auth-audit-stream
Maria: yep saw that. svc emitted events but the log sink dropped them during the rotation window
Jamie: can you paste the validator log snippet? might be helpful to see the kid values
Maria: pasted snippet:
```
[02:31:54] token-validator ERROR validate_token: token.kid=aa12... expected=bb34...
[02:32:01] token-rotator INFO rotate_keys: new_kid=bb34... started
[02:32:05] token-validator WARN keyset_mismatch: cache_miss
```
Ashwin: looks like rotator added new key, some callers cached old kid, validator cache didn't warm. fallback to introspect proxy prevented full outage but caused 401s
Ryan: root cause hypothesis: rotation sequence didn't run cache-warm step and audit-log sink backpressure caused missing events so we can't trace callers that hit 401
Olivia: agree. also we don't have an alert for "audit sink gap" — we only alert on sink errors, not silence
Jamie: proposed immediate actions:
- short-term: re-run key propagation job to warm caches (owner: Ashwin, due: today EOD)
- medium: add synthetic canary token rotation test during rotations (owner: Jamie, due: next Tue)
- medium: add silence detection alert for audit sink (owner: Olivia, due: next Thu)
- long-term: make rotation idempotent: ensure token-validator checks both current and previous key for 5m during rollouts (owner: Maria, due: 2 weeks)
Maria: adding one more: add a post-rotation trace that samples requester identity and logs to durable store for 24h (owner: Ryan, due: next Fri)
Ashwin: I'm on the re-run now. bumping priority and will post results in this thread
Olivia: I will add a grafana alert for no-audit-events-in-5m and a dashboard panel for sink lag
Jamie: updating runbook to include canary and cache-warm step. will open a PR
sec-bot: ACTION_ASSIGNED INC-2026-042: Ashwin, Maria, Olivia, Jamie, Ryan
Maria: quick check — does anyone rely on the old validator-only contract? we may need to notify internal teams of dual-key acceptance window
Ashwin: emailing infra-apps list now. cc: @jamie @olivia
Ryan: note for follow-up: audit retention should be long enough to help post-rotation forensic; current default 7d is fine but need higher sampling for first 24h after rotation
Maria: agreed. Ryan can you add retention note to the action item
Ryan: done. set retention sampling to 1h high-fidelity for 48h after rotation
Jamie: timeline sync: weekly check-ins for 4 weeks post-rollout to watch for recurrence (owner: Maria, cadence: weekly)
Olivia: also let's add a CI step: after terraform rotation plan apply, run a local canary that validates token acceptance across validators
Ashwin: re-run completed: cache-warm job pushed keys to 95% of validators within 90s, reducing 401s. will follow up with more telemetry tomorrow
Maria: thanks. can we add a short postmortem note to the incident tracker with root cause summary + owners? I'll draft and share
Ashwin: +1
Jamie: PR opened for runbook changes: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/pulls/42 :white_check_mark:
Olivia: alert created: AUDIT_SILENCE_5M, dashboard panel id=dh-rot-01
sec-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE INC-2026-042: mitigated -> monitoring; follow-ups assigned
Maria: marking action items below (copying into tracker):
- Ashwin: rerun cache-warm (done) / validation telemetry (due tomorrow)
- Jamie: runbook + canary test PR (in review)
- Olivia: audit-silence alert + dashboard (done)
- Maria: postmortem summary + weekly follow-ups (in progress)
- Ryan: retention sampling + post-rotation trace (in progress)
Ryan: will add synthetic logs to durable store today
Jamie: schedule for next sync: Tue 16:00 UTC
Maria: thanks team. continuing to monitor, please drop updates here. :thumbsup:
